dessin: One single software application window, as a simple map legend symbol: a landscape flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline and sharp square corners (no rounded corners). In the work area below, three small square boxes linked by thin ink lines like a small diagram. No logo, no product name, no screenshot detail. Nothing else.
